Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the WebSurfer agent failed to correctly resolve the conflicting birth year information for Ben Sombogaart. Although the initial search in Step 3 showed a discrepancy (Wikipedia listed 1974, while IMDb and TMDB listed 1947), the agent did not verify the Wikipedia entry before concluding the birth year was 1947. In Step 4, when explicitly instructed to check Wikipedia, the search results clearly showed the Wikipedia entry stating "born 8 August 1947". Despite this clear confirmation from the most authoritative source (Wikipedia) aligning with the other databases, the agent incorrectly maintained the confusion from Step 3 and did not explicitly confirm the resolution of the conflict in its analysis before declaring the task complete. The error lies in the failure to synthesize the new, clarifying evidence from Step 4 to definitively correct the perceived discrepancy, leading to a rushed conclusion without explicitly stating how the conflict was resolved, even though the data was actually consistent.
